problem_statement: The video-sw-generator (software camera) driver does not expose a test-pattern control. A test configures the chosen camera device with the VIDEO_CID_TEST_PATTERN control, sets its value to enable the color-bar pattern, starts the capture stream, and then dequeues frames to verify that each captured frame is an 8-color-bar pattern whose colors match the expected CIE-LAB targets within a configured threshold. When the driver does not register the test-pattern control, the attempt to set it fails and the test cannot run; the driver must register and support the test-pattern (menu) control so that setting it succeeds and the generated frames carry a valid color-bar pattern.
